name: co-VC Dimension / Positive Recursive Teaching Dimension (Incomparable)
details: Neither parameter has a universal affine-linear upper bound in terms of the other, even for finite classes.
parameter_1_larger_witness: For the addressing class $\mathcal A_n$, $\operatorname{coVC}(\mathcal A_n)=2^{\lfloor\log n\rfloor}$ while $\mathrm{PRTD}(\mathcal A_n)=1$.
proof: The canonical Addressing and Full Cube value calculations provide the two unbounded separations.
proof_source: Database-owned value proofs for co-VC Dimension and Positive Recursive Teaching Dimension of Addressing and the Full Cube.
